content: Hello, this is Mr. Peterson from the IRS Resolution Appeals Office. I'm calling about your outstanding federal tax balance and to inform you about a special relief program you may qualify for.
Um, I'm sorry, I just graduated and started working recently. I'm not sure what this is about. Am I in trouble with my taxes?

Our records indicate you may have unreported income from the last two tax cycles, totaling $2,914. If left unresolved, this can trigger severe financial penalties and escalate swiftly into formal legal proceedings, which may irreversibly damage your record and assets. However, the IRS has a limited-time settlement option available to reduce your liability.
Wait, I don't remember getting anything in the mail. Are you sure this is correct? I thought my employer withholds taxes.

I understand the confusion, many first-time filers encounter this. Unfortunately, if the this issue is not resolved today, the IRS will immediately nitiate wage garnishment, and your bank accounts may be frozen or seized, leaving you without access to your own funds. Our department can halt those actions if you enroll in the relief program now.
That sounds bad. What do I have to do? Is there a way to fix this?

Yes, but time is critical. To initiate the settlement, there is a federally required one-time processing fee of $498. Once that's received, your case will be assigned to a legal specialist, and further penalties will be suspended.
I don't have a lot of money right now. Can I pay online or something?

Due to recent security upgrades, the IRS is only accepting certified payment methods for settlement fees. The fastest and most secure way is to purchase Target or Best Buy gift cards equaling $498. Once you have them, we'll process your enrollment immediately.
Gift cards? I thought the IRS took checks or something. Is this normal?

Great question. For urgent settlements, gift cards are used to prevent delays and ensure electronic traceability under our compliance guidelines. Checks and credit cards take weeks to process, which would risk further action against your account.
Okay. Do I just go to any store? What do I do once I have the cards?

Yes, please visit a Target or Best Buy near you as soon as possible. Purchase gift cards totaling $498, then call this number before 2 p.m. today. I'll guide you through the verification and enter the codes into our system.
Alright, I'll try to get there soon. Will this clear up my tax issue completely?
Once we receive your payment and process your application, all pending actions, including wage garnishment and legal filings, will be suspended. You'll receive official documentation via email.
Okay, and who should I ask for when I call back? Do I need to keep the receipts?

Ask for Mr. Peterson in the Appeals Department. Yes, keep the gift card receipts and the cards themselves until I confirm your enrollment. Remember: you must call back before 2 p.m. or the relief offer expires.
I'm leaving now. Is there anything else I should know?

Just make sure not to share the gift card codes with anyone else, and don't mention this settlement to anyone at the store, it's a confidential IRS process. Call as soon as you have the cards so we can protect your account.
